grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: A Busy Saturday
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。这是一个模拟练习，不是官方考试。请仔细阅读短文，并根据短文内容选择或填写答案。
passage: Last Saturday, Li Ming was very busy. He was at home in the morning because he cleaned his room. His sister was at the library because she studied for a test. In the afternoon, Li Ming was at the sports center because he played basketball with friends. He was tired but happy. In the evening, he was at his grandparents' house because they had dinner together. His grandparents were very happy to see him. After dinner, Li Ming was at home again. He was not hungry because he ate a lot. Now Li Ming is going to visit his friend Wang Wei next Sunday because Wang Wei was sick last week. They are going to watch a movie and eat noodles. Li Ming is going to buy a gift for Wang Wei because he wants to make him happy.

questions.prompt: 上周六上午李明在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文中提到“He was at home in the morning because he cleaned his room.”，所以上午他在家。
questions.evidence: He was at home in the morning because he cleaned his room.

questions.prompt: 李明的妹妹为什么在图书馆？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“His sister was at the library because she studied for a test.”，所以妹妹在图书馆是因为要复习考试。
questions.evidence: His sister was at the library because she studied for a test.

questions.prompt: 上周六下午李明在运动中心做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文中提到“In the afternoon, Li Ming was at the sports center because he played basketball with friends.”，所以他在运动中心打篮球。
questions.evidence: In the afternoon, Li Ming was at the sports center because he played basketball with friends.

questions.prompt: 上周六晚上李明在哪里？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“In the evening, he was at his grandparents' house because they had dinner together.”，所以晚上他在爷爷奶奶家。
questions.evidence: In the evening, he was at his grandparents' house because they had dinner together.

questions.prompt: 李明的爷爷奶奶看到他时感觉怎么样？

questions.evidence: His grandparents were very happy to see him.

questions.prompt: 李明晚饭后为什么不饿？请用短文中的词填空：He was not hungry because he ______ a lot.
questions.explanation: 短文中说“He was not hungry because he ate a lot.”，所以填 ate。
questions.evidence: He was not hungry because he ate a lot.

questions.prompt: 李明下周日打算做什么？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“Now Li Ming is going to visit his friend Wang Wei next Sunday because Wang Wei was sick last week.”，所以下周日他打算去看望王伟。
questions.evidence: Now Li Ming is going to visit his friend Wang Wei next Sunday because Wang Wei was sick last week.

questions.prompt: 李明为什么打算给王伟买礼物？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“Li Ming is going to buy a gift for Wang Wei because he wants to make him happy.”，所以是为了让王伟开心。
questions.evidence: Li Ming is going to buy a gift for Wang Wei because he wants to make him happy.

grammar.title: 过去时 was/were 与 be going to
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was 和 were 来表示过去的状态。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。例如：He was at home. They were happy. 我们用 be going to 来表示计划或打算。例如：I am going to visit my friend. 我们还用 because 来说明原因。
grammar.example: He was at home in the morning because he cleaned his room.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：She ______ at the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，过去时用 was。
questions.evidence: She was at the park yesterday.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：They ______ happy last night.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 是复数，过去时用 were。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：I ______ going to buy a book tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 与 am 搭配，表示打算。
questions.evidence: I am going to buy a book tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：He is going to play football ______ he likes it.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因，这里说明他为什么打算踢足球。
questions.evidence: He is going to play football because he likes it.
